messages:
olivia: Anyone else seeing GPU pool count drop in eu-west-1? I just noticed 40% fewer nodes in the warm pool :confused:

kai: yeah saw that at 09:12, scheduling is failing on new nodes

raj: logs show iam:AssumeRoleDenied during node bootstrap

olivia: snippet from node-init:
```
2026-03-21T09:12:05Z ERROR: assume-role failed: AccessDenied
metadata: condition 'aws:RequestTag/epoch' mismatch
```

jordan: wait did someone roll the IAM role condition for ephemeral keys? :eyes:

security-alerts: Automated policy change applied: iam/role/infra-ephemeral -> condition 'epoch' updated by pgp:ops-change-bot at 09:10 UTC

kai: that would explain it — new nodes don't set the epoch tag until after bootstrap which means KMS decrypt for keystore fails

olivia: KMS decrypt errors seen too: `DecryptError: InvalidCiphertextException`

raj: current impact: warm pool nodes fail to join -> autoscaler scales up more but can't bootstrap -> capacity drop

jordan: short-term mitigation: revert the IAM condition to previous version. Who can rollback the change?

security-alerts: ops-change-bot audit id 88a1f, rollback runbook: https://confluence.internal/ops/iam-rollbacks

kai: I'll open a quick PR to revert the condition and kick the role change pipeline. pinging @cloud-admins

olivia: also need firewall check — some new firewall ACLs dropped egress to kms in the eu-west subnet earlier today. Could be two simultaneous issues :grimacing:

raj: good catch — I'll verify natgw routes and security group egress for 10.0.0.0/0 to KMS endpoints

jordan: if rollback not immediate, emergency fallback: map GPU jobs to other regions (ap-south/eu-north) and enable cross-region routing on the batch scheduler

kai: put a temporary canary route in the scheduler, moving low-priority batches first. I'll annotate cost estimate ~ +12% for cross-region egress

olivia: creating incident ticket INC-7221 with current blameless notes — linking probes + logs

sre-bot: Incident INC-7221 created by olivia. Status: investigating. Runbook steps posted.

security-alerts: audit log shows the policy change was requested by jessica@sec during compliance sweep — tagging for postmortem

olivia: thanks team. Action items: kai revert IAM cond, raj verify KMS/network egress, jordan prepare scheduler reroute plan. Update in 20m.

kai: started rollback PR: https://git.internal/infra/iam/pulls/412 — kicking CI

raj: natgw routes look fine, but there's a deny rule in subnet-nacl-305 that matches ephemeral node IP range. Opening rule tweak now.

olivia: updating INC-7221 with network tweak and PR link.

jordan: scheduler can reassign ~30% of queued jobs within 10m once canary enabled

sre-bot: Update: PR 412 merged at 09:28 UTC. Nodes are re-trying bootstrap.

olivia: seeing nodes come back into warm pool. current warm count ~+85% of previous baseline. monitoring for stability.

security-alerts: Marking change for audit and including remediation timeline. Postmortem assigned to jessica and olivia.

olivia: thanks all :heart: will follow up with blameless writeup and cost impact numbers tomorrow.
